component.$description: Component tokens. Each one is an alias to a semantic role; components take their colours from here only

outline.$description: Focus ring, shared by every component

radius.$description: Corner radius, shape "soft". control = buttons and inputs

target-comfort.$description: Button and input height 44 px, at least 44 × 44 px (SC 2.5.5, AAA)

focus.$description: Focus outline at least 2 px thick (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.13, AAA)

focus-offset.$description: Gap between focus outline and element

icon.$description: Icon sizes. An icon alone needs an accessible name (SC 1.1.1, 4.1.2); meaningful icons need 3:1 against their background (SC 1.4.11)

sm.$description: Small icon, inside dense text or tags

md.$description: Default icon, next to a label

lg.$description: Large icon, icon-only buttons (keep the 24 px target, SC 2.5.8)

layout.$description: Layout per breakpoint (Mobile 390, Tablet 768, Desktop 1024, Desktop XL 1440): one value per screen

measure.$description: Maximum line length for running text, in characters (CSS 70ch). SC 1.4.8 (AAA) asks for 80 or fewer

duration.$description: Motion durations. All drop to 0 with prefers-reduced-motion (SC 2.3.3, AAA)

1.$description: Cards and panels resting on the page

shadow.$description: Elevation, style "soft". A shadow never replaces a border: components keep border/default at 3:1 (SC 1.4.11). Forced colors mode removes shadows, so elevated surfaces also get a transparent outline. In Figma: effect styles Elevation/Light and Elevation/Dark

opacity.$description: Named opacities. Never put opacity on text itself: contrast is measured on the final colour

scrim.$description: Overlay for text on photos and behind dialogs, colour #0D1535: white text keeps 4.70:1 even over a white area of the image

glass.$description: Translucent surfaces (sticky header, toolbar), background/default at this opacity. Text contrast checked in the worst case, dark content scrolling underneath. Opaque with prefers-reduced-transparency
Background blur behind translucent surfaces. In Figma: effect style Blur/Glass

ratio.$description: Image aspect ratios. Always set width and height on so the space is reserved

display.$description: Display (.display), fluid 43 → 86 px between 390 and 1440 px. Passes AA with primary text on background (16.22:1).
